intro: Home is your daily desk. Logging here fills Foodiary and Progress — start with the orange Log control, not a scavenger hunt through tabs.
buddyTip: If Progress looks empty, ask “did I log on Home with real kcal?” before assuming a bug.
mission: Open Home, log one meal with Buddy, and watch Today’s Progress update.
why: Wrong-door logging is the most common frustration. People open Foodiary to invent a blank row, leave kcal empty, then wonder why Progress stays at zero. Home is built as the smart door into the ledger.
Home gathers the daily loop: Buddy Log / Talk food, quick actions (camera, mic, water), and Today’s Progress. That composition matches how successful days actually work.
Orientation saves willpower. When Home is the habit, the rest of the app becomes review and planning — not a maze.

what.lead: What you should recognise on Home.
points: Buddy Log / Talk food — the primary capture path
Quick actions — camera, gallery, mic, water
Today’s Progress — fills after logs with nutrition
Bottom tabs — Meal Plan, Foodiary, Progress, Spaces, Menu for other jobs
Deep coaching moments — confirm estimates before save when Buddy asks

misconceptions.myth: Home is just a dashboard; real logging happens in Foodiary.
misconceptions.truth: Prefer Home for new meals. Foodiary is for review and corrections.

misconceptions.myth: I need to fill every widget before logging.
misconceptions.truth: One honest log is enough. Ignore unused surfaces until you need them.

steps: Open the app to Home by default
Tap the orange Log / Talk food strip
Speak, type, or attach a photo of the meal
Confirm Buddy’s estimate; adjust grams if you know better
Glance at Today’s Progress — then return to life
how.buddyHelps: Buddy reduces friction and teaches while capturing. Progress on Home is immediate feedback that the loop worked.

sections.title: Quick actions
paras: Camera and gallery help when typing is slow. Mic helps when your hands are full. Water keeps hydration in the same ritual as meals.
Use the action that matches the moment — consistency beats loyalty to one input mode.

sections.title: Today’s Progress
paras: Treat it as a compass, not a courtroom. If it doesn’t move, check that the saved row has energy values and that you’re viewing today.

mistakes.quote: I added a Foodiary row with no kcal and thought Home was broken.
mistakes.why: Blank-kcal rows don’t teach Progress. Log via Buddy on Home or fill nutrition.

mistakes.quote: I ignore Home because there are too many numbers.
mistakes.why: Use one control: Log. Numbers can wait until the habit sticks.

mistakes.quote: I only open Progress tab, never Home.
mistakes.why: Progress needs inputs. Capture on Home first.

encouragement: Home is where honesty becomes easy. Tap Log, confirm, glance, go — that is a complete Buddy day starter.
